structure: Part 1 read e2e/about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js (351 lines) and e2e/support/journey.js (270 lines) in full. The spec has four describe blocks plus one germinal block, 20 tests in all, following DR2.1 task-list section 1 (About the consignment) under /design-release-2.1: 'notification type' (3 tests: /create-notification redirects to /notification-type with five type options, its required error, draft reference GBN-AG-26-..., a /live-animals dashboard 'Create new' that skips the type question, and plants for planting reaching an empty commodity search); 'origin of the import' (4 tests: title, heading, caption, country search placeholder, region of origin code Yes/No with hint, revealed code input with country prefix and 'Enter up to 5 characters.', empty-code error, internal reference field and hint, no hub button or cancel link, country optional, answers kept, country search pick); 'what are you importing' (5 tests: ITAHC copy, search label and hint, two action buttons, cancel link to /notification-hub, commodity code help and Trade Tariff link, 'Select a commodity' error, species search with result count and Latin-name checkboxes, selection panel with count, groups, per-species remove and Clear all, hub save without validating); 'main import reason' (7 tests: five reasons with hints, reason optional, internal market with 11 purposes and its required error, transhipment destination country, transit port of exit and destination country, temporary admission horses exit date and port of exit with real-date error, the /prototype/reason-for-import seed route); 'germinal products: section 1' (1 test: ?category=germinal-products start, back link to /germinal-products, germinal search hint and 'semen' results, reasons reduced to Internal market and Transit, purposes reduced to four). journey.js supplies the shared assertions these tests make (error summary title and linked messages, inline errors, back links, draft reference, action button values, the type-and-pick autocomplete, commodity selection hidden value, MOJ date picker input, species fixtures, the /design-release-2.1 mount); its later helpers (arrival, documents, addresses, transporter, consignment details) belong to other parts and are not claimed here. Claims keep the ids of the earlier part 1 extract: the spec and helper are unchanged since it, and every claim was re-checked against them. Gaps recorded: Potatoes and Wood products types, plants after the commodity page, hub save keeping a selection, Re-entry's reveal, and where a complete temporary admission answer leads.
